translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all20pageimages. No acquired prior English translation or translation service used. Selected dictionaries consulted; provisional individual terms and syntax explicitly noted per ID. No wholly uninterpreted utterance passed off as English. No independent specialist review. Following lexical recheck465:l021 is now explicitly unresolved_source and excluded from English row/word totals; partial English with unidentified noun retained only in unresolved_passages.

notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l001: Continuation of Koshoy’s speech from p462; his description of extraordinary peoples belongs to the epic, not verified ethnography.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l005: Single eye in the head translated literally; no named mythological people supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l009: Kap-Too retained as epic place-name, not equated with a modern mountain range.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l010: жайчы: ritual weather-conjurer; not an ordinary weather forecaster.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l012: Burning/death wording read as the speaker’s imprecation, not a completed death report.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l013: Compressed syntax: улугу арбын жаны бар rendered many lords and men; exact distribution of арбын remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l020: улама here oral tradition passed onward; not a collective of Islamic scholars.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l021: укумчу contextually those who have heard/received the tradition; exact archaic nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l023: Kara/black retained literally; манжуу rendered Manzhuu consistently within this batch.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l025: Forty raids retained as the source’s number without historical verification.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l034: Эрен retained as place-name Eren, distinguished from common noun эрен warrior.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l037: Zheti-Özön kept without modern geographic identification; sequence of exile and settlement is the source’s.
notes.manas-2010:p0463:b001:l038: жетик fulfillment/completeness; prayer’s exact promised benefit unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l005: мурас inheritance/legacy, used rhetorically as what they can gain by living.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l007: Six months, as printed; distinct from six days at470:l002.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l012: кайып unseen supernatural realm; no additional named adviser supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l016: Printed ааламды (world), not silently changed to аламанды (raid/raiding host). The clause across016–017 remains syntactically difficult; “stirred” is a provisional contextual rendering of салган.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l017: See464:l016: unusual world/place clause preserved, with rhetorical Кошой эмеспи retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l020: калган contextually had remained/lived through the preceding experience, rather than inventing a specific new deed.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l027: Comparison to a thousand men implicit in миңден көп; source does not specify the comparator as a thousand named sages.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l034: белге тийчү жер: provisional tactical reading “where to strike their flank”; could be figurative exhortation reaching one’s strength/resolve. Earlier unsupported smooth wording removed.
notes.manas-2010:p0464:b001:l037: Standalone horse phrase retained as verse; no missing verb invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l005: Hand ablution explicitly retained, as is foot ablution at007; not compressed into one prayer-preparation row.
notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l010: ыймамы imam; unusual Айдоого болду read contextually as urging onward. Exact idiom provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l011: Printed амаз understood as namaz/prayer; raw spelling retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l015: Lengthening cruppers and shortening breast girths at018 retained in printed order.
notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l021: Printed Ататтарын has no corroborated nominal meaning; neither transliteration nor unverified spelling change counts as translation. notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l024: Bag-like nose comparison retained literally as epic grotesque imagery.
notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l028: тобокел religious resolve/entrusting oneself to God; rendered as an English exclamation.

notes.manas-2010:p0465:b001:l041: Katagan tribal designation retained; banner held by Koshoy at042.
notes.manas-2010:p0466:b001:l002: казат religious military campaign in the epic speech, rendered holy campaign.
notes.manas-2010:p0466:b001:l014: жезнай brass wind instrument; чыңыроон a shrill sounding, not a named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0466:b001:l017: Printed байдадан visually confirmed. Yudakhin байда II = gain/profit, I = appearance; neither securely resolves the rhetorical formula. “The campaigner fears no gain.” is a deliberately literal provisional rendering, NOT a verified idiom. Earlier guessed “hardship” removed because unsupported. Requires specialist/parallel-witness review; grammatical core is interpretable.
notes.manas-2010:p0466:b001:l018: акшыктап read as noisy snorting/excited breath; human heroic expression, not an added horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0466:b001:l029: жонумдуулар broad-backed/powerful men, retained among the ranks.
notes.manas-2010:p0466:b001:l031: 031–034 kin restrain eager men to avert pointless death; quotes and thought attribution are editorial.
notes.manas-2010:p0466:b001:l039: мындан көп repetitive comparative retained with many more, not collapsed with subsequent parallel lines.

notes.manas-2010:p0467:b001:l015: Ravines of thought metaphor retained; no literal troop detour inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0467:b001:l023: Aykozho, proper name; robe is multicolored. Anzhiyan retained as the Kyrgyz city-name form.
notes.manas-2010:p0467:b001:l025: On account of his son, as printed; the son and motive are not invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0467:b001:l028: Bukhara mullah not expressly named here; not silently equated with Aykozho in the preceding passage.
notes.manas-2010:p0467:b001:l031: Literally “with my own eyes I will bury”; English “see to their burial myself” preserves personal witnessing/responsibility without changing eyes to hands.
notes.manas-2010:p0467:b001:l039: Buudayyk is a named veteran hero; not translated as the common noun wheat.
notes.manas-2010:p0467:b001:l042: кулача dun-colored horse per shared lexicon; not a unit of armspan.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l001: тумарча amulet-shaped forehead blaze; source does not state that an actual amulet is tied there.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l006: өлөң song/verse, particularly appropriate to the Kazakh hero; not grass.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l009: Compressed death/separation phrasing rendered people bereaved and separated from their people; exact relation remains provisional, not resurrected dead warriors.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l016: каркыбар heroic laudatory epithet, here valiant, following dictionary check recorded in prior batch.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l018: Sash worn as turban retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l020: кожо religious title retained as khoja; курган conveys pity rather than a fortification.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l028: Printed compound Кудайназар-Куучокмор retained as Kudaynazar-Kuuchokmor; no unverified split into two separate men.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l036: кеңитип relieving Manas’s predicament; continuation of rescue intention, not proof that contact has already occurred.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l037: Printed Кароолоду алган жол менен remains syntactically awkward. Provisional road/watch reading retained; no assumed new place named Karoolodu.
notes.manas-2010:p0468:b001:l038: тосуптур meet/intercept; translation does not add a completed conversation with Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0469:b001:l002: баткал marsh/mud; variant form retained in raw text.
notes.manas-2010:p0469:b001:l007: таш тулга stone hearth supports, not a helmet.
notes.manas-2010:p0469:b001:l008: Groups of ten per fire; source does not explicitly give a total number of fires.
notes.manas-2010:p0469:b001:l009: жанказан portable traveling pot, per Karalaev edition glossary; no nonverse apparatus added to verse.
notes.manas-2010:p0469:b001:l016: сонун fresh grazing ground in camp context, not simply a beautiful spectacle.
notes.manas-2010:p0469:b001:l021: Narrator’s verse transition remains English verse; only separate b002 heading excluded.

notes.manas-2010:p0469:b003:l010: таштуу stone-adorned/badged officials; role inferred from repeated stone-wearing Kytay formula, no invented badge material.
notes.manas-2010:p0469:b003:l014: Manas and Kutubiy are targets of the surrounding Kytay advance, not a sudden change of attackers.
notes.manas-2010:p0470:b001:l002: Six days literally, distinguished from six-month speeches elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0470:b001:l014: Tyrgoot ethnic/troop designation retained, no historical identification forced.
notes.manas-2010:p0470:b001:l015: карыпчы armguard, per shared lexicon; not an aged man.
notes.manas-2010:p0470:b001:l021: Kakan retained as the epic’s sovereign/title; taking Manas to him is an intention, not an accomplished capture.
notes.manas-2010:p0470:b001:l031: Yudakhin and2015 dictionary ЖЕКЕНЕ = leather belt, with exact белге курчанган formula. Corrected from earlier vague mighty-waist draft.
notes.manas-2010:p0470:b001:l038: бөйрөк flank (anatomically kidney); army formation context supports flank here.
notes.manas-2010:p0471:b001:l006: Where is Zholoy? is Manas’s taunt, not a narrator’s geographic uncertainty.
notes.manas-2010:p0471:b001:l007: Six thousand struck down retained as source number.

notes.manas-2010:p0471:b001:l033: Hyperbolic bottomless depth retained; no measured depth supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0471:b001:l035: бойлобойт inability to reach/find footing in water; precise horse action provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0472:b001:l007: Курганда contextually at least/at any rate three thousand; possible pity nuance retained in note. Distinct from six thousand killed471:l007.
notes.manas-2010:p0472:b001:l010: Tash-Kechüü named ford retained; Zholoy knows it, not an invented bridge.
notes.manas-2010:p0472:b001:l015: тозуп contextual blocking/guarding, variant of тосуп; raw unchanged.

In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0472:b001:l026: таза shaven men in recurrent Kytay tonsure description; not a judgment of moral purity.
notes.manas-2010:p0472:b001:l028: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.

notes.manas-2010:p0472:b001:l036: Iron ropes and nets retained as epic equipment without reconstructing a mechanism.
notes.manas-2010:p0472:b001:l038: Dagger-bearing men line is a fragment continued by lament; not excluded as prose.

Draft adopts south in the difficult кызык чалдырып formula (“throw the south into turmoil”), provisionally. Exact idiom/syntax unresolved; not silently expanded to кыямат.
notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l007: айдар long tuft/forelock worn down the back; not all head hair.

notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l022: кара бас- evil spirit affliction, potentially childbirth-demon allusion in reference to wife; no actual obstetric event added.
notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l023: Unusual fugitive/nearby escape simile retained literally; exact idiomatic implication uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l024: бек таштап tentatively flinging forceful words; grammatical linkage provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l026: Possessive fragment Manas’s preserved across the intervening command027.
notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l029: Six months explicitly retained, without harmonizing with six days470:l002.
notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l034: түмөн rendered myriad in quoted contrast with a single Burut; numerically ten thousand is also available.
notes.manas-2010:p0473:b001:l042: бил elephant, not know/waist; exact drunken-elephant simile retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0474:b001:l003: See473:l014 on near-slaughter aspect; deaths at006 explicitly translated.
notes.manas-2010:p0474:b001:l017: кыя cliff-path/slope, contrasted with the known ford; no new place-name assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p0474:b001:l019: Spears cannot reach across the water; firearms are explicitly named at021 and025.

notes.manas-2010:p0474:b001:l027: Armor torn, as printed; no factual claim of universal physical destruction outside this episode.
notes.manas-2010:p0474:b001:l038: His father a giant, as printed; no unprovided father’s name.
notes.manas-2010:p0474:b001:l042: Accusative champion from Kap-Too continues into475:l001. Read as an opponent whom Orgo can lay low; syntactic transition is awkward and not emended.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l001: Continues474:l042: he lays the champion low in grappling, not a missing verse or new protagonist.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l003: оргок dictionary variant of орок sickle; reaper-like quality contextually tied to mowing opponents at015. Exact derived оргоктук epithet provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l008: Steel tip and brass shaft preserved, including repeated formula in477.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l025: Fire from mouth singeing mustache retained as epic hyperbole; no naturalizing paraphrase.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l029: Kakan-chyn retained as epic sovereign designation; fortress metaphor applied to Orgo.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l031: саз here fine/favorable appearance, not marsh; contradiction with intimidating face elsewhere not silently harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l034: Capital Балтай read axe in weapon-haft comparison, not the body/shaft of a character named Baltay.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l036: селебе broad cutting sword; no specific modern weapon model asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l040: төр upper/honored place or upper valley; upland hollow adopted in topographical face simile. Exact terrain reference provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0475:b001:l042: батман variable traditional weight retained as batman, with twelve explicit; no unsupported kilogram conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l003: чабак small fish: comparative belittling of other champions.

notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l007: берени rendered warrior as subject; could evoke берен steel/armor in this dense equipment formula. No claim of secure parsing.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l014: далдалы чыгуу tearing to shreds: destructive combat, not simple departure.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l021: God-struck narrator’s curse; referent potentially Orgo alone rather than greeting khans, so pronoun in English is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l024: бучкак lower trouser leg: contemptuous comparison preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l027: Elliptical Kara-Suu crossing line; not supplemented with ford or bridge.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l029: булдурсун heavy fighting whip; black-jawed image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l034: Without turning, twisting neck: apparent distinction of bodily turn and neck twist retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l035: Printed Бозкачыр: gray mule, not silently transformed into a horse; also separated Боз качыр478:l001.
notes.manas-2010:p0476:b001:l041: Literally no care for brow/eyebrows, idiom interpreted as risking one’s skin. Repeats480:l033.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l005: топчулук button-loop, not button proper; nine retained. Yudakhin confirms топчулук чыгар- = unbutton; corrected line005 and retained006.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l014: Twelve members traditional complete-body formula, not twelve literal modern anatomical limbs.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l015: Forty chiltens spiritual companions retained; no invented additional protectors.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l020: Subject switches back to Orgo for his spear attack through024, then Manas evades. Editorial subject supplied only at024 to clarify.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l025: Торучаардан locative/ablative horse maneuver rendered leaning aside on Toruchaar; no complete dismount introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l036: болжолу жок literally beyond measure; unmeasured retains heroic size/strength ambiguity.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l039: Both repeated tearing-through rows039 and041 retained separately.
notes.manas-2010:p0477:b001:l040: жүлүн marrow/spinal cord; backbone marrow is literal draft, not an anatomical correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0478:b001:l017: Three heroic epithets separately retained; not substituted by Manas’s name.
notes.manas-2010:p0478:b001:l021: Helmet and чарайна plate armor both printed before “flew off his head.” Odd anatomical scope preserved rather than silently moving armor to torso.
notes.manas-2010:p0478:b001:l024: Printed repetition Манас, Манас жөкөрү preserved, not collapsed into one name.
notes.manas-2010:p0478:b001:l027: Ажыратып алгыча before separation/rescue; Orgo supplied as contextual object, rescuers unnamed.
notes.manas-2010:p0478:b001:l030: ат generic mount in this formula; mule explicit elsewhere, not silently made a horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0478:b001:l034: Orgo did not die/all Beejin died is the lament’s hyperbolic contrast; not evidence Orgo survived.
notes.manas-2010:p0478:b001:l040: түмөн кол rendered ten-thousand host; a myriad is an alternate rhetorical force.
notes.manas-2010:p0479:b001:l002: Net as protection for Kakan: тозгон read covering/shielding; metaphor retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0479:b001:l016: Exposed spot aimed at; no invented vulnerable anatomical target.
notes.manas-2010:p0479:b001:l019: Toruchaar is explicitly the desired target, not Manas himself in this command.
notes.manas-2010:p0479:b001:l026: Printed менде read as speaker’s inability in context; unusual morphology retained raw.
notes.manas-2010:p0479:b001:l030: калдай governor per shared glossary; distinct from khan at031.
notes.manas-2010:p0479:b001:l035: бөйрөк troop flank, not physical kidney in this tactical positioning.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l004: One versus one thousand retained as epic number, not harmonized with earlier army totals.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l007: акыр-такыр emphatic extremity rendered utterly hemmed in from surrounding attack; not Manas’s death, contradicted by following action. Exact idiomatic force provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l008: Reeds/flood image retained in full, not explained away as a count of spears.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l019: топ cannon, supported by shot emerging at020–021; not group of men in these rows.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l027: саадак literally bow/quiver, by metonymy its arrows rain down; not actual quivers thrown.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l033: Subject shifts to Manas’s fearless counterattack in033–040; no copied Orgo action.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l034: Death less than a hair, literal idiomatic scale retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0480:b001:l037: көк жал wolf/hero epithet rendered lone blue-maned wolf; not a new literal animal combatant.
notes.manas-2010:p0481:b001:l003: Same-day births asserted by narrator; not independently verified chronology.
notes.manas-2010:p0481:b001:l008: оорук rear/baggage portion of army, not illness; wordplay with оорубас not reproducible exactly.
notes.manas-2010:p0481:b001:l022: кайдалап seeking/calling “where?” read as Manas taunting their strongest, continuing his attack; not strongest men asking where. Possessive/subject is compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p0481:b001:l030: Kutubiy’s pledge begins here; identification follows at034, not Ezkara pledging to protect Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0481:b001:l036: Куту shortened form of Kutubiy, not a different character.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l006: кызык battle excitement/intensity, not amusement about a separate event.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l009: Narrator’s transition is verse and remains translated, not a prose exclusion.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l012: карыпчы armguard, consistent with shared lexicon and470:l015.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l015: ала көөдөн rash/reckless, applied in compressed phrasing before Айкөл; provisional attachment to Manas, possibly epithets split across Zholoy/Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l021: Puffing up at being called Manas, taunt; not a factual physical growth event.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l027: кочку village headman per Yudakhin, as checked for406:l035; source capitalization alone does not require a new proper name Kochku.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l029: Zhorukuyruk and Zhoon retained as named opponents with giant title; no omission of either.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l031: ордо horde/court/host and ор- mow play on sound retained through horde/mow in sense, not English sound.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l038: бээлеп know fully/with mastery; exact unusual adverb remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0482:b001:l040: Karakan as forefather; not equated with Beejin’s Karykan at476:l012.
